subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked with a merge base, docgate shall fail any diff modifying the gate-policy keys of the pyxis config surface — `grandfathered_designs`, `precedence_grandfathered`, and `capability_paths` — unless the commits carry the `Governing-Change: operator` trailer.
rationale: the gate's exemption surface is policy, and policy changes are never self-serve (INV-19's pattern applied to the doc gate; #54 D1)
fit_criterion: an untrailered diff adding a slug to `grandfathered_designs` red; the same diff trailered green; untrailered edits to `paths`/`templates`/`system` keys green; the real config green
